title: Is Brown Rice Really Healthier?

scenes.text: Many believe brown rice is always the healthier choice.
scenes.label: MYTH: Brown rice is always better.
scenes.hook_top: MANY BELIEVE BROWN RICE IS ALWAYS

scenes.text: While brown rice offers more fiber, it also has higher phytic acid, which can inhibit mineral absorption.
scenes.label: TRUTH: Nutrient absorption differs.

scenes.text: Consider your overall diet and specific nutritional needs when choosing rice.
scenes.label: TAKEAWAY: Choose wisely!

scenes.text: Follow for daily tips to feel your best.

description: Is brown rice truly the superior option? Discover the truth about its nutritional impact compared to white rice. Follow for more health insights!
